source_title: Pick of the stats: West Ham United v West Bromwich Albion - BBC
source_excerpt:
West Ham United will be aiming for the top spot on the Championship table on Saturday but visitors West Bromwich Albion will have their own automatic promotion ambitions when they kick-off at London Stadium (15:00 GMT).
The Hammers are sitting just outside the top two as it stands, just one point below second placed Swansea and three adrift of leaders Middlesbrough.
However, Albion are only two points shy of the Swans themselves and will be hoping for a chance to get into the automatic promotion spots.
West Ham United have won their last three league games against West Brom, as many victories as across their prior 15 meetings combined between 2008 and 2017.
